cold_screen.label: Calculation / Inference (3V3 window, D-R12-139): Calculation on the netlist values and the 3V3 window (R12F6-TRI-03); D120 VF (BAT54C 25 C maxima extended to -42 C), the match and leads, the R164 drop and zero leakage are Inference
cold_screen.reading: healthy needs PC5 well above 0 and PC0 inside the healthy band; open reads PC5 0; a bridge across R131 (or R136) or R173 (or R129) with a match fitted reads above the healthy PC0 band in every corner (margins above), so the screen refuses it; without a match every case reads PC5 0 and is refused as open. A shorted match reads as a healthy one (band edges differ by about 0.01 mV): the screen cannot see it, and R134 limits that case in a fire. A J121 terminal to GND reads 0 / 0. Firmware thresholds are not set here: bench the bands (zero leakage, ADC offset and reference error assumed)
cold_screen.topology: 3V3 -> R136 5.1k -> D120 (BAT54C A1 -> K) -> R131 5.1k -> PYRO1_OUT (10.2 kohm, R12F6-TRI-01); PYRO1_OUT -> R173 5.1k + R129 5.1k -> PC0 over R130 || R178 (2k || 2k); RAW_ACT -> R132 5.1k + R175 5.1k -> PC5 over R133 || R180; a match joins PYRO1_OUT to RAW_ACT through R134 2R

gate.note: Q120 / Q121 VGS = -(V_ACT_FET_S - 0.1 V) x (R119 || R120) / ((R119 || R120) + R121), V_ACT_FET_S = BAT_IN less Q120's drop during a fire (Q122 drop 0.1 V and the Q120 hot factor Inference). |VGS| exceeds the AO3401A +/-12 V only above 14.4 V pack-side with the bus enabled (a transient up to the SMAJ12CA clamp); the bus is enabled from the on-rail check until switch-off (Inference that no transient above 14.4 V occurs while it is on, pad or flight; R12F4-TRI-03). Q124 VGS: PE4 VOH >= VDD - 0.4 V (DS12110 Rev 8 Table 158, |IIO| 4 / 8 mA; PE4's steady load, R127 1k plus R126 220R + R128 10k, is about 3.5 mA (<= 3.93 mA with drift at the 3V3 PFM-band maximum), within the 4 mA row; R12F3-TRI-06, R12F4-TRI-02, R12F6-TRI-03) through R126 220R / R128 10k, at the 3V3 drift minimum (SLUSDW3A section 7.8 PFM band) with R126 / R128 at their drift ends (R12F5-TRI-05); the Q124 VGS and PE4 load figures: Calculation / Inference (3V3 window, D-R12-139)
